boundary.scope: Seven production generic receipt/cancellation/native dispatcher files and three changed smoke test sources only. New capture e2e/census/docs changes and later source/test additions require their own final snapshot review.

findings.title: Canceled observer may outlive join and terminate reused worker
findings.originalLocation: macos_receipt_session.request finally: monitor.join(timeout=.25) then unconditional native._LOCK.release
findings.reproductionBySource: Observer has seen cancel/current session and entered delayed child.terminate; request completes normal exchange while observer remains alive beyond250ms; finally releases lock and successor can reuse same Popen; delayed observer then terminates successor request worker. No native execution required to establish this interleaving.
findings.impact: False native failure and worker-lifetime crossover; not identified as admission or unsafe-promotion bypass. Reused input infrastructure predated generic integration, but new real SDK cancellation exposes it to capture/OCR.
findings.repairObserved: Finally now calls monitor.is_alive after bounded join and, while still holding request lock, closes/quarantines only expected exact session and raises typed unknown if observer survives. _close_owned(expected) refuses to close a different _SESSION. A delayed observer can only later signal its retired old Popen.
findings.testSource: test_delayed_old_cancel_observer_cannot_reuse_or_terminate_successor_worker uses actual thread/lock and mocked exchange/Popen/session cleanup; gates old terminate beyond join interval and verifies unknown,old retirement,new worker completion,and only old termination.

sourceAssessment.result: GENERIC_OPERATIONS is capture/status/ocr.image/ocr.languages. validate_features validates bounded known unique string list, absent field means no generic support. Actual helper advertises four literals; generic request requires supported operation before semantic exchange. Old input-only helper refuses explicitly; no legacy one-shot fallback.

macos.request active operation routes to receipt_request with original payload/timeout and generic=True before legacy child/2slot path. Contextless exactstatus exception and no-operation one-shot route remain original. Required mode lost context for other ops still refuses. New active route deliberately shares single input worker and nonblocking_LOCK.

RequestExecution holds real Event+write Lock; copied _request context observes same object. Async cancellation signals before tool_terminal persistence; scopefinally signals before journal close. Generic adapter picks up these actual handles and existing independent observer can terminate exact worker without waiting for journal fsync. This does not make asyncio.to_thread itself cancelable; late worker/journal/Stop behavior still needs actual acceptance.

Only fully valid control plus four literals selects generic dispatcher. ownedFrame captures exact current receipt object identity; challenge is filled once by existing entry handshake before business dispatch. Finish/publish accesses completion and global frame state only on main runloop, checks exact active frame pointer, ignores duplicate completion, writes one terminal, then resets/signals once. Input route retains original single handler-entry hook; no reentrant-enter weakening.

Static HandleRequest was exported as RuyiAutomationRequest and existing one-shot main calls same body. Session generic entry invokes hook once before same body, input family still calls InputRequest once. Unknown generic operation rejects in Python before worker creation; no-control persistent session does not gain generic surface.

Caller65/15/3 forwarded unchanged; native session watchdog60 for negotiated generic OCR and12otherwise; entry/continue2seconds unchanged. Existing aggregate native output bound68MiB and own cleanup remain. No performance or deadline runtime qualification inferred from static code.
